I added a sleep between sandbox calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. I haven't run the test, since it calls the live sandbox.

- **The change:** After each `requests.post` in `test_charges_roundtrip`, the test now waits `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL`, which I set to 0.25s. At 5 requests per second, calls need to be at least 0.2s apart, so this leaves a little headroom. It adds about 1s to the test (4 calls).
- **Memory:** I saved the sandbox's 5 requests/second limit in EngramDB, so future sessions will know to space out calls in any new tests that hit the sandbox.

If more tests start using the sandbox, a shared throttle helper or retrying on HTTP 429 would hold up better than sleeps in each test.
